description: This source file defines an extension for the OnboardingView class, adding a method that initiates a chat onboarding process if certain conditions are met. It manages the onboarding chat lifecycle, including a delay loop to wait until the chat model is ready and then sends an initial message to the user.

classes.description: The class that is extended with additional onboarding chat functionality.

methods.name: maybeKickoffOnboardingChat
methods.description: Checks conditions and initiates the onboarding chat by sending an initial message if appropriate.
